name: Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-R6 'Warden'
description:
The Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-R6 is a six-shot double-action revolver chambered in .44 Magnum with an integrated smart-link system and BCI-connected targeting suite. The frame is forged titanium alloy — lighter than steel while maintaining the strength needed for magnum pressures — and the barrel features Arcturus's CeraShield coating. The weapon combines the reliability and power of a traditional revolver with neural-integrated aiming technology.

The Warden represents Arcturus's answer to operators who trust revolvers but want smart-link capability. The BCI system provides the same real-time ballistic overlay as the ARC-SL9 but calibrated for the .44 Magnum's different trajectory profile. The system also monitors the cylinder rotation and maintains an exact round count, feeding ammunition status directly to the shooter's awareness — solving the revolver's traditional weakness of uncertain round count under stress.

The combination of revolver simplicity and smart-link precision creates a weapon that appeals to experienced operators making the transition to neural-integrated firearms. The Warden doesn't jam, doesn't fail to feed, and doesn't require magazine management — it simply works, and the BCI system makes it work better. For operators who have trusted wheel guns their entire careers, the Warden makes the case that technology and tradition can coexist.
legality: Restricted — BCI registration and enhanced firearms license required
specifications:
caliber: .44 Magnum
effective_range: 65 meters (smart-linked)
rate_of_fire: Double-action revolver
magazine_capacity: 6 rounds (cylinder)
weight: 1.18 kg
BCI_latency: <8ms
tactical_use: A smart-linked magnum revolver combining traditional reliability with neural-integrated targeting. The BCI overlay provides precise aiming data and real-time ammunition tracking. The .44 Magnum round delivers superior stopping power against armored and augmented targets. The revolver mechanism eliminates the feed-related malfunctions that can affect semi-automatic smart weapons. Limited by six-round capacity and slow reloading.
cultural_context: The Warden is the weapon that ended the argument between revolver purists and smart-link advocates — or at least changed it. Operators who swore they would never carry a 'computer gun' make an exception for the Warden, because underneath the technology, it's still a revolver. Arcturus understood their audience perfectly.
known_users: Elite bounty hunters who prefer revolvers
story_hooks: A Warden's BCI system is hacked mid-engagement, providing the shooter with false targeting data that causes them to miss a critical shot. The hack came through the weapon's own neural connection.
An unregistered Warden appears with its BCI system wiped — someone has figured out how to factory-reset Arcturus smart-link weapons, removing all tracking and registration data.

physical_description.visual_profile: A distinctly traditional revolver silhouette with subtle cybernetic integration—compact and purposeful, neither sleek nor angular. The Warden reads as 'old technology elevated' rather than 'new technology disguised.' The cylinder dominates the profile, positioned prominently. Minimal extraneous details; function-forward design.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length: 23.8 cm | Barrel length: 10.2 cm | Cylinder diameter: 4.1 cm | Height at grip: 14.5 cm | Width at frame: 3.2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly balanced despite magnum caliber. Hefty but not unwieldy—1.18 kg settles naturally in the hand with a low, stable center of gravity. Feels engineered rather than crude.
physical_description.primary_material: Forged titanium alloy frame and cylinder; CeraShield-coated barrel; reinforced polymer grip module with embedded haptic feedback nodes
physical_description.finish: CeraShield barrel exhibits a satin gunmetal-grey finish with subtle iridescent heat-stress patterning. Titanium frame in anodized matte charcoal-grey with micro-brushed highlights catching light. Cylinder rotates with precise mechanical resistance—visible wear grooves from firing.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal-grey titanium with gunmetal accents. Grip inlays in tactical black with silver BCI connector interface at the rear.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with raised diamond-pattern grip surface for secure purchase even with tactical gloves. Warm to the touch—material absorbs body heat rather than conducting it. Haptic feedback nodes embedded subtly beneath the surface; imperceptible unless actively receiving neural input.
distinctive_features: Integrated BCI neural-link interface—silver contact array recessed into the grip backing, barely visible until examined
Cylinder features engraved round-count markers (1-6) along the frame interface; small LED indicator beneath frame shows ammunition status (micro-display, active only during neural link)
Cocking nib (hammer) refined to military precision—distinct audible and tactile feedback with each rotation
Trigger guard slightly oversize to accommodate neural-integrated trigger mechanism; micro-actuators visible beneath polymer casing
Hammer safety detent engraved with ARCTURUS logo and serial plate on the left side—minimalist branding
Muzzle crown exhibits visible stress-polishing from magnum pressures; CeraShield coating shows minor burn marks from heavy field use—expected wear
Cylinder arbor interface shows precision manufacturing tolerances—no wobble, no rattle
Rear sight is low-profile with tritium dot (faintly glowing green); front sight is sharp and reduced for BCI overlay compatibility
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS laser-etched in small, precise lettering along the left barrel flat. Serial number and BCI registration code stamped discreetly on the frame beneath the cylinder. ARC-R6 MODEL designation on right side of frame. No chrome plating or ostentatious branding—professional restraint.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-maintained and well-used. The CeraShield barrel shows burn patterns and minor oxidation from sustained fire; the cylinder exhibits light striations from ammunition rotation. Grip shows minor wear from repeated draw cycles. Everything functions with machined precision—this is a weapon that sees regular use and receives proper maintenance. Not pristine, not battle-scarred; lived-in professional condition.
